scope: Predefined five-disclosure convenience register: industry/no-own-loss earnings reference in2022 plus first CALM own-loss disclosure and FY2024 followup earnings disclosures. Not an exhaustive event census. Dec2023 price result already known; Jan2024 negative earnings news encountered during source discovery. No fresh holdout claim.
rules: Retain all five rows regardless of outcome. Use next-common-session close and five common-session interval exit; show initial prior-close reaction separately. Benchmarks XLP/SPY are broad comparisons, not unaffected egg producers. No pooled alpha estimate, causal regression or significance test: two geographic episode groups, repeated updates and three earnings-overlap rows among four own-loss/update rows. Prior public egg-price context may be stale and is not certified original vintage.
